text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Duti Hiburan

(Pengecualian) (No. 2) 2021.

(2) Perintah ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 September 2021.

Pengecualian

2. Tiket masuk bagi tayangan filem dengan tajuk yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual

yang diadakan dalam tempoh dari 1 September 2021 hingga 31 Disember 2021

di Pawagam Tanjong Golden Village (TGV) di Wilayah Persekutuan Kuala Lumpur

dikecualikan daripada duti hiburan.

Menteri Kewangan

ENTERTAINMENTS DUTY ACT 1953

ENTERTAINMENTS DUTY (EXEMPTION) (NO.2) ORDER 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 12(1)(b) of the

Entertainments Duty Act 1953 [Act 103], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Entertainments Duty (Exemption) (No. 2)

Order 2021.

(2) This Order is deemed to have come into operation on 1 September 2021.

Exemption

2. The admission ticket for the movie screenings with the titles specified

in the Schedule which are held within the period from 1 September 2021

until 31 December 2021 at the Tanjong Golden Village (TGV) Cinemas in

the Federal Territory of Kuala Lumpur is exempted from entertainments duty.
